objective: Collect up to 1,000 distinct NGS protocols in total; stop earlier if defensible candidates are exhausted.
counting: A registered, source-identified protocol counts as collected only when actual chemistry-source reading yields preparative facts and source-qualified notes. Abstract/identity/processing-only notes and registration do not count. Catalogue status and computed model completeness remain distinct; collection does not claim a publishable or fully validated graph. Do not count copied names, incidental parameter variants, reviews or non-NGS methods.
scope_rules: Published defining article first; check source identity, supersession and corrections.
Inspect defining original plus chemistry supplements before following links.
Source investigation cap: 10 minutes and 3 originals per protocol; record actual scope and deferred targets.
Do not infer confirmed missing information from unavailable sources or empty scraping; retain the two-independent-reader absence gate.
Implement justified protocol-local graphs and new neutral model primitives where needed; never invent source chemistry or borrow a family recipe by resemblance.
Prioritize breadth; move past inaccessible sources and leave pending/notes entries accurately marked.
Only the coordinator edits shared catalogue, citation snapshot, metadata vocabularies, AUDIT and this plan. Workers own disjoint protocol dirs/review records and dedicated discovery ledgers.
Stage verified task files, preserve unrelated existing changes, never commit third-party originals or generated HTML.
